summary: North London meets West London with both sides pressing high and leaving space in transition.
analysis: Arsenal average 2.1 goals at home this season while Chelsea concede frequently on the road against top-half sides. Five of the last six meetings produced three or more goals. Expect an open midfield and late chances if the score is level after 70 minutes.

summary: Anfield pressure and Brighton's travel form point to a home result.
analysis: Liverpool remain ruthless at Anfield against possession-oriented visitors. Brighton create chances but ship goals when pressed into their own third. Home win is the cleanest angle; BTTS is a secondary consideration only.

summary: Two attack-minded sides with soft defensive stretches away from midfield control.
analysis: Newcastle convert set-pieces at a high rate at St James' Park. Tottenham score in most away fixtures against sides that leave space behind the full-backs. Neither defence has been airtight in recent weeks.

summary: Bernabéu control against a Sevilla side still rebuilding defensive shape.
analysis: Madrid's home expected goals remain elite. Sevilla travel poorly and concede early when pressed. A routine home win is the primary angle; Asian handicap -1.5 is for higher risk only.

summary: Basque derby intensity usually tightens the middle third and slows chance creation.
analysis: Recent derbies have been low-event and physically contested. Both sides prioritise structure over open transitions. Under 2.5 aligns with shot volume and set-piece dependence.

summary: Open midfields and aggressive full-backs on both sides.
analysis: Girona invite pressure then punish transitions. Villarreal create consistently from wide areas. Defensive metrics for both lean toward goals at each end.

summary: San Siro edge without overcommitting on a straight win price.
analysis: Inter control territory at home and limit Napoli's counter lanes. A draw remains possible in a chess-match midfield, so draw-no-bet offers cover while keeping upside on an Inter win.

summary: Bergamo tempo plus Fiorentina's transitional threat.
analysis: Atalanta generate high shot volume at home. Fiorentina score away when games open up after the hour. Over 2.5 has hit in a strong majority of recent head-to-heads.

summary: Derby caution and mid-block discipline typically suppress open play.
analysis: Rome derbies rarely become track meets. Both managers value structure; set pieces decide more than sustained attacks. Under 2.5 is the disciplined angle.

summary: Bayern's home ceiling against a mid-table defence.
analysis: Bayern dominate possession and create high-quality chances inside the box. Wolfsburg struggle when chasing games. Covering -1.5 is reasonable given recent home margins.

summary: Two of the league's most vertical attacks meet in an open fixture.
analysis: Dortmund and Leipzig trade high expected goals when they meet. Defensive transitions are the weak link for both. BTTS is the highest-conviction market.

summary: Freiburg's home organisation against Stuttgart's travel variance.
analysis: Freiburg are hard to break down at home. Stuttgart create but leave gaps after turnovers. Avoiding an away win is the safer frame.

summary: Parc des Princes control against a Nice side that sits deep away.
analysis: PSG convert territorial dominance at home. Nice defend well in patches but rarely create enough to flip these fixtures. Straight home win is preferred to inflated handicaps.

summary: Emotion-heavy fixture with both attacks capable of punishing mistakes.
analysis: OM–OL often opens after the first goal. Shot quality on both sides supports goals; under is only attractive if both start ultra-conservative.

summary: Lille structure vs Monaco's away scoring threat.
analysis: Monaco score regularly on the road. Lille create enough at home to keep BTTS live even if they control periods of the match.

summary: City's European home form remains the clearest edge.
analysis: City control tempo and restrict counters at home in Europe. Sporting are organised but struggle to sustain pressure against elite midfield presses. Home win is the primary pick.

summary: Two expansive systems rarely produce a cagey European night.
analysis: Historical shot volume and open midfields in this pairing support goals. Under only becomes interesting if both managers signal extreme caution in the first half.

summary: Italian European caution meets Benfica's controlled away approach.
analysis: Milan manage risk at San Siro in Europe. Benfica are patient and low-event away against top sides. Under 2.5 is the disciplined European angle.
